items.english: Outside the door, where darkness had fallen unnoticed, there was the sound of driving rain and wind. A storm.
notes: いつか is indefinite in the Japanese, grown dark before anyone marked it; I keep it as unnoticed rather than giving a time.

items.english: The parents and the child were gathered at the table beneath the dim electric light hung close to the wall of the narrow room, about to take their supper for the night. Both father and mother were still truly young. And the child was a roundly plump little girl, just able to stand by holding to the table.
notes: 親子 is singular in form but here covers father, mother and child; I render it as parents and the child to keep the third-person distance of the opening.

items.english: Neither the man nor the woman had yet a single wrinkle in the face. But in the man's hollowed kindly eyes in the shadow of his thick eyebrows there was a look of heavy tiredness. And about the woman's dark hair and her slight shoulders there was a still deeper, sunken tiredness, and a drowsy peace.
The day had ended. The sorrow and the suffering of that day were on the point of flowing into the peace of the night. And they, smiling in silence, bent their eyes upon everything in the child.
notes: I keep smiling and everything literal here to hold the repetition chain that runs through the story.

items.english: Standing as if she might topple, the child tried with fat, round, ball-short hands to sweep at what was on the table, without a moment's pause and far too quickly. So they, still smiling, set everything, the tea bowls and the earthen teapot and the aluminium pot, down under the table. Upon the table there remained only the small spoon the child held and a single small dish.
notes: I keep everything and still smiling to match p4; vessels are left plain without explanation.

items.english: But the child gave a noisy cry full of small delight and banged the spoon and the dish down upon the table.

data.say: Drafted the crowded opening supper in plain period register, keeping storm, smile and everything repetitions for the frame.
